ios.desc:
Join millions of players worldwide in the most played Solitaire game in history - now featuring MORE great games to play!

Enjoy classic Solitaire game modes everyone loves - Klondike Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, TriPeaks Solitaire & Pyramid Solitaire. Keep your mind sharp increasing Difficulty, completing Daily Challenges, playing Weekly Rewards, or climbing the leaderboard in Events. 

Celebrate WINS by leveling up with XP, collecting Trophies, Achievements & MORE! Plus, discover other great match-3, arcade and puzzle games ready to play anytime - Microsoft Bubble, Jewel, Gravity Blocks, Gem Drop & Mahjong 3D.

Sign in with a Microsoft or Xbox Account to save your progress, collect awards and play across devices.
With so much to play, Microsoft Solitaire Collection is the perfect app for anyone.

Features:
• 5 favorite Solitaire game modes
• 5 NEW Challenges every day
• Choose your Difficulty
• Weekly Rewards, Events & Achievements
• MORE great games ready to play inside

Become a Premium Member
• Play Ad-FREE
• Collect XP (win or lose)
• Daily Challenges: 2x points & access to past Challenges
• Unlimited use of Solitaire Solver
• Special boosts in Endless TriPeaks & Pyramid 
• Extra bonuses in other games 
• FREE Retro bundle & Xbox card backs

Solitaire Premium is available for mobile only. Non-transferrable to other platforms.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account on confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews monthly or annually depending on the subscription type purchased. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. If auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, you will not be charged for the next period. All cancellations will take effect at the end of the current period.

For more information visit: https://aka.ms/microsoftsolitaire_support
